final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avgp, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM s1) SELECT AVG(s1.avgp), AVG(s1.cnt), AVG(s1.cnt - s2.avgcnt) FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avgcnt IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avgcnt
